metadata.title: Tesla Stock Slides—and a 5-Day Win Streak Would Mask Risks<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tesla Stock Set to Snap Win Streak. Its Rough Stretch Isn’t Over.
Tesla stock was on track to snap a four-session winning streak on Wednesday. The electric-vehicle maker is struggling to turn a corner following a rough stretch.
